title: Cloverfield Public Services

texts.label: A
texts.heading: Riverside Library — Membership
texts.text: Riverside Library offers free membership to all residents of Cloverfield aged five and over. Bring proof of address, such as a recent utility bill, to join at the front desk. Members may borrow up to eight items for three weeks, with online renewal available unless another reader has reserved the item. Overdue items are charged at 20 pence per day, up to a maximum of £5 per item. The library opens Monday to Friday, 9 a.m. to 7 p.m., and Saturday, 10 a.m. to 4 p.m.; it is closed on Sundays and public holidays.

texts.label: B
texts.heading: Northbank Sports Centre — Autumn Course Timetable
texts.text: Northbank Sports Centre's fitness classes run from 1 September to 12 December, closed during the half-term week of 26–30 October. Beginner swimming is held on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 6 p.m., £4.50 per session or £38 for the term if paid in advance. Yoga classes take place on Monday mornings at 9.30 a.m.; places are limited to eighteen and must be booked two days ahead through reception. Junior badminton coaching, ages eight to fourteen, runs on Saturdays at 10 a.m. and requires a signed parental consent form.

texts.label: C
texts.heading: Cloverfield City Transport — Travel Card Rules
texts.text: The Cloverfield Travel Card can be loaded with credit at any station machine or via the free mobile app. A single adult fare within Zone 1 costs £2.10, while a weekly pass covering Zones 1–2 costs £24.00. Children under eleven travel free when accompanied by a fare-paying adult, up to two per adult. Cards must be touched on entry and exit; failure to touch out results in a default charge of £6.50. Lost cards can be replaced at any staffed station for a £3 fee.

texts.label: D
texts.heading: Elm Court Apartments — Recycling and Waste Guide
texts.text: General waste is collected every Monday from the bins behind Block C; please have bags out by 7 a.m. Recycling, including paper, glass and plastic bottles, is collected on alternate Thursdays — check the colour-coded calendar in the entrance hall for exact dates. Food waste caddies are emptied twice weekly, on Tuesdays and Fridays. Large items such as furniture are not collected with regular waste; residents must book a separate collection through the estate office at least five working days in advance.

texts.label: E
texts.heading: Bridgewater Language Centre — Enrolment Information
texts.text: New students at Bridgewater Language Centre should complete a short online placement test before choosing a course, as classes are grouped by ability rather than age. Ten-week courses begin in January, April and September; late enrolment is possible within the first two weeks of term at a reduced fee. Course materials cost an additional £15, payable at registration. Students who attend fewer than 70% of sessions will not receive a certificate. For enquiries, call 01632 960 021, 9 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday to Friday.
